data.one_liner: Flutter package to build chat UIs with multiple message kinds like text, image, HTML, and carousels.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of widgets and controllers to build chat interfaces supporting multiple message types, quick replies, carousels, custom messages, and built-in themes. It handles message rendering, scrolling, and input fields out of the box.
use_when: You need to quickly implement a chat interface with support for various message types like text, images, and HTML.
You want built-in support for quick replies, carousels, and custom message rendering.
avoid_when: You require a fully custom chat layout that drastically diverges from standard chat bubble paradigms.
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.41.0.
strengths: Supports multiple message kinds including text, image, HTML, quick replies, and carousels.
Includes M3 design system integration and responsive utilities.
Provides a ChatController for imperative actions like scrolling to the bottom.
weaknesses: Requires a recent Flutter version (3.41.0 or later).
Limited documentation outside of provided markdown files and example apps.
